source: class Item { public int Number = 7; }
class Catalog { public static List<Item> Items = [new()]; }
class Bag<T> { public List<T> Values = []; public int N = 2; }
class Holder<T> { public Bag<List<T>> B = new Bag<List<T>>(); }
class TargetHolder<T> { public Bag<List<T>> B = new(); }
class Box<T> { public T Value; public int N = 3; }
class ListBox<L> : Box<List<L>> { public int M = 4; }
class Hold<T> { public Box<List<T>> Listed = new ListBox<T>() { Value = [] }; }
class Base<T> { public T Value; }
class Derived<U> : Base<U> { public U Other; }
class Pack<T> { public Bag<T> Inner = new(); public int Z = 1; }
class Shell<T> { public Pack<T> P = new Pack<T>() { Inner = new() { N = 9 } }; }
class Deep<T> { public Shell<T> S = new Shell<T>() { P = new Pack<T>() { Inner = new() { N = 8 } } }; }
class Wrap<T> { public Bag<T> Inner = new() { N = 5 }; public Pack<int> Q = new() { Z = 4, Inner = new() { N = 5 } }; }
class Cell<T> { public Bag<T> Slot = new(); }
class Nest<U> { public Cell<List<U>> C = new(); }
class Nest2<V> { public Nest<List<V>> M = new(); }
class Cell2<T> { public T Own; }
class Nest3<U> { public Cell2<List<U>> C = new() { Own = [] }; public Hold<List<U>> H = new(); }
class Nest4<V> { public Nest3<List<V>> M = new(); }
class Maker<T> { public int Make() { Bag<T> b = new Bag<T>(); return b.N + b.Values.Count; } }
class Nest5<U> { public Maker<List<U>> K = new(); }
class Probe {
public static Holder<int> H = new Holder<int>();
public static Hold<int> D = new Hold<int>();
public static Base<Reference<Item>> R = new Derived<Reference<Item>>() { Value = Catalog.Items[0]!, Other = Catalog.Items[0]! };
public static int FreshN() { return new Holder<string>().B.N; }
public static int StoredCount() { return H.B.Values.Count; }
public static int StoredAdd() { H.B.Values.Add([1, 2]); return H.B.Values[0].Count; }
public static int TargetN() { return new TargetHolder<string>().B.N; }
public static int DerivedN() { return new Hold<string>().Listed.N; }
public static int DerivedStoredCount() { return D.Listed.Value.Count; }
public static int DerivedAdd() { Hold<int> h = new(); h.Listed.Value.Add(5); return h.Listed.Value[0]; }
public static bool ReferenceShared() { return R.Value == Catalog.Items[0]!; }
public static Deep<int> E = new Deep<int>();
public static int ShellN() { return new Shell<int>().P.Inner.N; }
public static int ShellValues() { Shell<string> s = new(); s.P.Inner.Values.Add("a"); return s.P.Inner.Values.Count + s.P.Z; }
public static int DeepN() { return new Deep<string>().S.P.Inner.N + new Deep<string>().S.P.Z; }
public static int DeepStored() { E.S.P.Inner.Values.Add(3); return E.S.P.Inner.N + E.S.P.Inner.Values[0]; }
public static Wrap<string> W = new();
public static int WrapFreshN() { return new Wrap<string>().Q.Inner.N + new Wrap<string>().Inner.N; }
public static int WrapStored() { W.Q.Inner.Values.Add(7); return W.Q.Inner.Values[0] + W.Q.Z + W.Inner.N; }
public static Nest<int> NS = new();
public static Nest2<int> N2 = new();
public static int NestAdd() { NS.C.Slot.Values.Add([4, 5]); return NS.C.Slot.Values[0].Count + NS.C.Slot.Values[0][1]; }
public static int NestFresh() { Nest<string> n = new(); n.C.Slot.Values.Add(["x"]); return n.C.Slot.Values[0].Count + n.C.Slot.N; }
public static int Nest2Add() { N2.M.C.Slot.Values.Add([[1, 2, 3]]); return N2.M.C.Slot.Values[0][0].Count; }
public static int Nest2Fresh() { Nest2<string> n = new(); n.M.C.Slot.Values.Add([["a", "b"]]); return n.M.C.Slot.Values[0][0].Count + n.M.C.Slot.N; }
public static int Nest3Own() { Nest3<int> n = new(); n.C.Own.Add(9); return n.C.Own[0]; }
public static int Nest3Listed() { Nest3<int> n = new(); n.H.Listed.Value.Add([4]); return n.H.Listed.Value[0][0]; }
public static int Nest4Own() { Nest4<int> n = new(); n.M.C.Own.Add([9]); return n.M.C.Own[0][0]; }
public static int Nest4Listed() { Nest4<int> n = new(); n.M.H.Listed.Value.Add([[4]]); return n.M.H.Listed.Value[0][0][0]; }
public static int MakerN() { Nest5<int> n = new(); return n.K.Make(); }
